facets.description: Plural *_ids branch (store.js.es6 lines 196-201) always deletes the original key and stores failed _lookupSubType results as falsy entries, unlike the singular branch, which only replaces the key when the lookup succeeds
obj[k].map is called without checking for a null or non-array value, so it can throw a TypeError
The `hydrated || []` fallback is dead code because .map always returns a truthy array
Widening the regex to /(.+)\_id(s?)$/ now consumes existing *_ids attributes (e.g. subcategory_ids, muted_category_ids) that used to pass through unchanged
